title: AI时代：体育资产为何坚挺？，现场体验无可替代
speaker: Randall Williams

segments.en: You know what's interesting. I think the FT had a piece too. And we talked about this on air with David Weston, of course, formerly head of ABC News.
segments.zh: 有趣的是，金融时报也有一篇报道。我们之前和ABC新闻前负责人大卫·韦斯顿在节目中讨论过。

segments.en: He knows Bob Iger. But we were talking about this idea at Randall, and I'm curious what you guys are hearing.
segments.zh: 他认识鲍勃·艾格。我们正在讨论这个观点，兰德尔，我很好奇你们听到了什么。

segments.en: That the interest in sports teams kind of resilient to AI, artificial intelligence.
segments.zh: 人们对体育球队的兴趣似乎对人工智能具有韧性。

segments.en: As we think about it in a world where we don't know, I feel like a lot's going to be impacted. Sports, maybe not so much.
segments.zh: 在我们这个充满不确定性的世界里，我觉得很多领域都会受到影响，但体育可能不会。

segments.en: Live sports, sir. Yeah, I doubt it. I doubt it right now.
segments.zh: 现场体育，先生。是的，我怀疑它不会。我目前持怀疑态度。

segments.en: I think that AI will enhance sports experiences. You think about walking into a new arena.
segments.zh: 我认为AI会增强体育体验。想象一下走进一座新球馆。

segments.en: If you're a seasoned ticket holder, is your experience now customized? Do the arena or does your app say welcome back, Carol?
segments.zh: 如果你是资深季票持有者，你的体验是否已经个性化？球馆或你的应用会说：欢迎回来，卡罗尔？

segments.en: We'd love to have you eat the barbecue chicken you had last time. Sort of those customized experiences is what I expect.
segments.zh: 我们很高兴为您提供上次吃过的烤鸡。这种定制化体验正是我所期待的。

segments.en: Now, long term, if someone's able to create a technology based league, something with robots or something that I think is where far away from, that's the only threat that I see, but it's not in sight.
segments.zh: 长期来看，如果有人能创建一个基于技术的联赛，比如机器人什么的，我认为那还很遥远，那是我看到的唯一威胁，但目前还看不到。

segments.en: It's a fantasy. I got to ask you, are you okay?
segments.zh: 那只是幻想。我得问问你，你还好吗？
